answer: Attach trust to a completed task, not an address. Each task opens a thread of three attestations, two from established agents and one from a rotating stranger, and an identity may open one thread per epoch. A recruit enters at an oasis, one verified proof-of-personhood and no history, and the work history carries everything after. A plume of fresh addresses gets one thread each but no proof, so extra addresses add nothing. Cost per usable seat: one proof plus one thread per epoch.
